answer: The falcon counter is kept in fable and pearl publishes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3838 identities would post 670 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
